name: remote-lib-ui
description: Search University of Indonesia's library databases from Claude using your own SSO login.
long_description: Search 25+ University of Indonesia subscribed databases (ScienceDirect, IEEE Xplore, JSTOR, Scopus, SpringerLink, and more) directly from Claude. Logs in with your own UI SSO credentials over the EZproxy gateway, runs filtered searches (with an OpenAlex metadata fallback for sites that resist scraping), and resolves full-text / PDF download links. Everything runs locally on your computer; your credentials never leave your machine.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a database with optional year/author/open-access filters.

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: Resolve the PDF / full-text link for an article.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Read a page through the proxy as markdown/text.

tools.name: get_proxy_url
tools.description: Get an authenticated link to open in a browser.

username.title: Library username
username.description: Your UI SSO username (the NetID you log in with, not your email).

password.title: Library password
password.description: Your UI SSO password. Stored securely in your OS keychain; it never leaves your computer.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)
openalex_api_key.description: Leave blank. Only needed for a higher metadata-search quota.

disabled.title: Hidden databases (optional)
disabled.description: Comma-separated database slugs to hide (e.g. heinonline,scival). Leave blank to keep all.
